1879244001.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879244001.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline enhances the Captain's role as the Standard-bearing, inspirational leader of the Free Peoples. This enhances their ability to turn the tide in battle.

1879244257.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879244257.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline focuses on distraction and placing enemies in the way of danger.

1879252321.name: Destroy Foes of Gondor!
1879252321.desc: This powerful sword strike does incredible damage to an enemy of Gondor, and Boromir can use it more often than lesser Men.

1879269217.name: The One Trap
1879269217.desc: Places a  trap at a target location that deals heavy damage upfront and over time while slowing the enemy's movement speed.

1879302625.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Maid-at-arms)
1879302625.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879330273.name: Ice Salamander
1879330273.desc: Summons a salamander to keep you company.

1879358817.name: Harvest Revelry Kite
1879358817.desc: Brings out a harvest revelry kite for you to fly!

1879463009.name: Brown Cow
1879463009.desc: Summons a brown cow to accompany you on your journeys.

1879478497.name: Recuperate
1879478497.desc: You consume some of your Wrath to regain some Morale in the heat of battle.

1879488737.name: Call to Bears
1879488737.desc: Beseech a wild Bear to aid you.

1879495137.name: Fantastic Fern
1879495137.desc: Place down a magnificent potted fern.

1879497697.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497697.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879521249.name: Pale Zizanu
1879521249.desc: Summons a helpful pale zizanu to accompany you on your travels.

1879527393.name: Essence of the Vanquished
1879527393.desc: Use the Essence of the Vanquished to delay your Curse of the Gaurhoth.

1879528801.name: Prepared: Frost-spike
1879528801.desc: Send a spike of ice at your target. In so doing, you are covered in an icy shell.
